_comment: URLs/domains that automated checks cannot reach. Seeded from prior manual verification work. New entries are appended automatically by detect-changes.ts after 3 consecutive failed automated checks. Nothing here is auto-removed -- if a site starts working again, delete its entry by hand or just leave it (it's simply skipped going forward).
_girft_note: GIRFT hosts (gettingitrightfirsttime.co.uk, girft-interactivepathways.org.uk) are skipped because automated requests to them are unreliable -- they return HTTP 403 to bots while loading normally in a browser. IMPORTANT: skipping here does NOT prove those URLs are permanently healthy; it only stops the automated dead-link checker from mis-reporting them as broken. GIRFT links still need occasional manual/browser review to confirm they resolve.
